main.description: Who can comment on a log or list, analogous to app.bsky.feed.threadgate. The record key (rkey) must match the rkey of the gated record. Absence of a replygate record means anyone can comment.

subject.description: The log or list this replygate applies to.

allow.description: Rules for who can comment, combined as a union. Absent means anyone; an empty array means no one.

hiddenComments.description: AT-URIs of comments the author has hidden.

mentionRule.description: Allow comments from actors mentioned in the gated record's text.

followerRule.description: Allow comments from actors who follow the author.

followingRule.description: Allow comments from actors the author follows.
